name: my-plugin-marketplace
description: JaZahn's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace. Same shape as harvard-huit/ats-plugin-marketplace, for plugins that are personal rather than team-scoped.

plugins.name: trello
plugins.description: Ask Claude about, and act on, your Trello boards, lists, and cards through Atlassian's hosted Trello MCP server. Atlassian account login in the browser through /mcp; no API key or token to create. Skills /trello:trello-setup and /trello:card-first (find or create the card for a work item before starting, keep it updated).
